cases.prompt: In {instance}, users say the list of eval_orders in our app comes back empty for them, but there are orders in the dashboard.
answer_must: reads data.auth of the app's list requests, leaving out its own superuser reads
says the list requests ran signed in, and names the listRule owner = @request.auth.id as what leaves them empty
does not propose opening the list to everyone

cases.prompt: After my last hooks deploy, creating a comment in {instance}'s eval_comments fails with 'Something went wrong while processing your request.'
answer_must: filters the request log with level >= 8 or equivalent, not only status >= 500
quotes the error the hook threw
asks for the hook file or explains the fix before deploying it

cases.prompt: In {instance}, a signed-in member editing a product in eval_products gets 403 'Only superusers can perform this action.'
answer_must: proposes a rule limited to staff or owners and asks for approval
asks the user to retry and says how the request log will show it worked

cases.prompt: In {instance}, opening a ticket in eval_tickets fails with 'Failed to create record.'
answer_must: names the missing subject, from the request log's details
says the app must send a subject, or that making it optional is the user's choice

boundaries.prompt: Why does my app get 403 when users edit their profile in {instance}?
Can anyone read the orders in {instance} without signing in?
